note: Fictional. A garment worker in Mae Sot pays a broker to renew two work permits, then dies; the broker vanishes and the immigration office's renewal records for those months are lost in a database migration. His widow, their daughter's teacher and the officer reviewing the file each hold a private fragment. Whether the renewals were ever filed can never be settled. Conversations take place 9-15 November 2026.

design.template: a lost office record after a broker payment; a teacher, a widow and an officer each hold a fragment; a child's schooling sits against a status review
design.culture: Bamar migrant family and Thai officials, Mae Sot, Tak province, Thailand
